_comment: Designated fork fixes on picaye/hermes-agent: commits that MUST be ancestors of every deployed checkout HEAD and of the running gateway's code_sha. The post-deploy guard (hermes_cli/deploy_guard.py) asserts this after every updater checkout move and gateway boot. Add an entry when a fork-only fix must never be silently dropped by a detached-tag deploy; drop entries once the fix is merged upstream.

fix(release): fit an automated canary changelog inside GitHub's 125k body limit
fix(deps): npm lockfile bumps for the post-sync Dependabot wave (Oct-12)
fix(deps): urllib3 2.8.0 + tornado 6.5.10 in uv.lock (Dependabot wave)
